Hero.description: Your gateway to the treasures of civilizations: from Babylon to Egypt, China, Greece, and the Gulf
Hero.imageAlt: The pyramids, Babylon, Greece, and China in one city

gulf.label: THE GULF · الخليج
gulf.title: The Golden Coast
gulf.body: From the shores of the Arabian Gulf, where frankincense and pearls meet, the story of 3WEEQ begins. From this seafaring cradle we draw fragrances carrying the clarity of the horizon, the warmth of the sand, and the spirit of the trade routes that connected civilizations.
gulf.alt: The shores of the Arabian Gulf — frankincense and pearls

babylon.label: BABYLON · بابل
babylon.title: The Lamassu
babylon.body: From the Ishtar Gate, where stories are told through cuneiform. From Babylon, the cradle of civilizations, we draw fragrances that carry the scent of history and preserve secrets for millennia.
babylon.alt: The Lamassu of Babylon — guardian of the Ishtar Gate

egypt.label: EGYPT · مصر
egypt.title: The Sphinx
egypt.body: The Sphinx, the silent guardian of the Valley of the Kings. From Egypt, where gold meets eternal secrets, we craft royal fragrances embodying the luxury of the Pharaohs and the immortality of the Nile.
egypt.alt: The Sphinx, silent guardian of the Valley of the Kings

greece.label: GREECE · اليونان
greece.title: Marble Memory
greece.body: From the marble of Athens and the myths of Olympus, where tales of gods and heroes are woven. We present classic fragrances that blend Greek elegance with timeless modernity.
greece.alt: The marble of Athens and the myths of Olympus

china.label: CHINA · الصين
china.title: Silk & Stone
china.body: From the Great Wall of China and the silk of empires, where power meets elegance. We present captivating fragrances embodying the wisdom of the East and the details of ancient Chinese civilization.
china.alt: The silk of empires and the Great Wall of China

FirstChapter.title: MESOPOTAMIA
FirstChapter.subtitle: Babylon — Cradle of Civilizations
FirstChapter.body: From the banks of the Tigris and Euphrates, tales were born to live forever... A fragrance that mirrors the soul of Babylon, answering history's call with luxury.

Featured.title: RAFID
Featured.tagline: A fragrance that leaves the Gate of Ishtar
Featured.materialBody: Hand-finished glass, etched from Babylonian clay.
Featured.storyQuote: “What is told in clay is told in scent.”
Featured.storyBody: From the Tigris and the Euphrates, to a flacon in your hands.
Featured.closingBody: Insured shipping · Certificate of authenticity · Numbered edition

StoreInvitation.title: Discover a World of Civilizations
StoreInvitation.body: From the depths of Babylon to the spell of Egypt, from the marble of Greece to the silk of China. Step into the 3WEEQ store to own pieces that tell the stories of history.

Packaging.title: A Legacy in Your Hands
Packaging.body: At 3WEEQ, we don't just craft fragrances; we craft experiences. Every box is a work of art inspired by Babylonian engravings, made with the finest materials to reflect the luxury of ancient civilizations. From the moment you unbox it, your journey into a world of royal details begins.

gulf.title: The Gulf — The Golden Coast
gulf.body: From the deep waters of the Gulf, where divers descended for pearls, and from the ports of frankincense and oud that bound the East to the world, 3WEEQ begins its tale. Fragrances that seal inside the bottle the salt of the sea, the warmth of the sands, and the spirit of ancestors.

china.title: China — The Silk Empire
china.body: From the Great Wall of China to the silk of empires, where power meets refinement. Discover captivating fragrances embodying the wisdom of the East and the details of ancient Chinese civilization.

greece.title: Greece — Dawn of Wisdom
greece.body: From the marble of Athens and the myths of Olympus, where tales of gods and heroes are woven. A classic olfactory journey blending Greek elegance with timeless modernity.

egypt.title: Egypt — The Land of the Nile
egypt.body: The Sphinx, the silent guardian of the Valley of the Kings. From Egypt, where gold meets eternal secrets, we craft royal fragrances embodying the grandeur of the Pharaohs and the immortality of the Nile.

Beyond.title: A Boutique Inspired by the Depth of Civilizations
Beyond.body: A complete experience spanning fragrances, incense, smokers, textiles, leather goods, and curated pieces from different cultures. We don't just make perfume; we craft a lifestyle worthy of you.
Beyond.imageAlt: The 3WEEQ boutique — a lifestyle inspired by civilizations
